name: KLE to KiCAD Layout
description: Import keyboard layout from keyboard-layout-editor.com JSON and auto-place switch/diode footprints
description_full:
A KiCAD plugin that imports keyboard layouts from keyboard-layout-editor.com (KLE) JSON files and automatically positions switch (SW) and diode (D) footprints on your PCB.

Features:
- Parse KLE JSON format
- Auto-place Cherry MX compatible switches
- Auto-place associated diodes with configurable offset
- Support for rotated keys
- Support for different key sizes (1u, 1.5u, 2u, etc.)
- GUI for configuration
